component.name: Sofa Remote
component.summary: Control your Roku TV from the desktop

description.p: Sofa Remote turns your computer into a remote for a Roku TV or player on the same network. It finds the TV by itself, and nothing needs to be installed on the TV.

ul.li: All the remote's keys, from the mouse or the keyboard
See what is playing, and pause it with your keyboard's media keys
Open any channel with one click
Type into search boxes on the TV from your keyboard
Send a YouTube link to the TV
Play videos, music and photos from a folder on your computer
Color themes, some with a moving background

description.p: Sofa Remote is an unofficial app. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Roku, Inc.

screenshot.caption: The remote, channels and sharing in a wide window

description.p: New: the TV's volume level with a slider, one-click routines, a mini mode, live typing, a TV info panel, the sleep timer in the tray, starting at login, and commands you can bind to your own keyboard shortcuts. Shared videos offer their subtitles and pictures to the TV. On Windows the app now has a tray icon and answers the media keys.

New: search every channel from the app, hold buttons to repeat, channel up and down, more inputs, a sleep timer, a channel filter with pinning, waking a sleeping TV and a notice when a newer version is out. Folder sharing is safer: it serves only visible media files and Stop ends playback at once.
Groundwork for a Flatpak version: the launcher, icon and window now share one app ID, and the tray icon works inside a sandbox.
Roku Remote is now Sofa Remote. Saved settings carry over, and the icon is teal.
